Nina: ok this is my new roommate, meet Mr. Buttons 🐀
Nina: he decided my teacup was a chaise lounge and also my knitting pile is a bed
Nina: :camera_with_flash: https://i.imgur.com/placeholder.jpg

Nina: @Aisha yeah my partner made it yesterday, pattern link: https://example.com/teacup-rat-sweater — warning: tiny needles required
Luis: also the angle looks like a mug ad. 10/10
Aisha: we need a zoom background of this. someone make it 1920x1080? :laughing:
Nina: here's the nerdy photo meta: `f/2.8 1/60s ISO400` — phone was proud
giphy-bot: *posts GIF of a tiny runway show in sweaters* :tophat:
Luis: can confirm stitches are superior.
Aisha: quick poll — should we start a 'bring your pet to standup' day? :raised_hands:
Nina: only if they wear sweaters :sweat_smile:
Luis: +1 for structured sweater dress code
Aisha: also adding 'no teacup rentals for chairs' policy (jk)
Nina: thanks for the love <3
